description: Configure the 'example-repo-local' repository to prevent artifact overwrites (immutability). Log in to Artifactory at http://localhost:8082 (admin/password). Navigate to Administration > Repositories > Repositories > Local, edit 'example-repo-local', and uncheck the 'Allow Redeploy' (or 'Allow Overwriting') option. Verify that existing artifacts cannot be overwritten while new artifacts can still be deployed.
